traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria that are marked as in-scope for Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are implemented and verified. `traceability/require-story-annotation` and `traceability/valid-annotation-format` both expose ESLint auto-fix behavior via `fixable: "code"`, with implementations that add missing @story annotations and perform minimal, safe path-suffix normalization only. These behaviors are covered by the dedicated Jest tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts, which exercise before/after code transformations across multiple function patterns and story path variants. Error handling is conservative: ambiguous or unsafe situations result in plain validation errors without fixes. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md accurately describes the available auto-fix capabilities and clearly calls out unimplemented future enhancements (configurable templates and selective fix types), matching the story’s own notes. Given this alignment between specification, implementation, tests, and documentation, the story is fully satisfied in its current defined scope.
